recipe_name: Light Minestrone Soup
ingredients: 1/2 cup of cooked beans, 1/4 cup of whole wheat pasta, 1 carrot - 1/2 zucchini - 1/2 cup of spinach,1 tomato, Garlic, onion and EVOO
instructions: Sauté garlic and onion, Add vegetables and water, Incorporate pasta and beans, Cook until everything is tender

recipe_name: Lentil and oat burger
ingredients: 1/2 cup of cooked lentils, 1/4 cup of oats, 1/4 of onion, 1 tbsp of EVOO, Cumin, garlic and salt
instructions: Crush the lentils with the oats and seasonings, Form burgers, Cook on the grill, Serve and ready

recipe_name: Curry chicken with cauliflower rice
tag: Gluten free, Lactose free, Low in carbohydrates
ingredients: 150gr of chicken breast, 1/2 cup of coconut milk, 1 tbsp of curry paste, 1 cup of grated cauliflower
instructions: Cook the chicken with coconut milk and curry, Saute the cauliflower as if it were rice, Serve the curry over the cauliflower, Serve and ready

recipe_name: Portobello and pepper fajitas
ingredients: 2 whole wheat fajitas, 2 large portobello mushrooms, 1/2 red pepper-1/2 onion, 1 tbsp of EVOO, Cumin, paprika and salt
instructions: Cut and sauté the vegetables with spices, Serve on hot fajitas, Roll up and ready

recipe_name: Tuna salad with avocado and hard-boiled egg
ingredients: 1 can of natural tuna, 1/2 avocado, 1 boiled egg, Mix of green leaves, EVOO, lemon
instructions: Mix all the ingredients, Dress with oil and lemon, Serve and ready

recipe_name: Whole wheat pasta with sautéed vegetables and tofu
ingredients: 1 cup of cooked whole wheat pasta, 100gr of tofu, 1/2 zucchini-1/2 pepper- 1/2 onion, 1 tbsp of soy sauce
instructions: Brown the tofu in the pan, Sauté the vegetables, Add tofu and soy sauce, Mix with the pasta

recipe_name: Red Lentil Curry
tag: Gluten free, Lactose free, High in protein
ingredients: 1 cup of red lentils, 1 chopped tomato, 1/2 onion - 1 clove of garlic, 1 tbsp of curry powder, 200ml of coconut milk, EVOO and salt
instructions: Sauté the onion and garlic in oil, Add tomato and curry, Add lentils and coconut milk, Cook 20' until thickened

recipe_name: Baked salmon bowl with brown rice and broccoli
tag: High in protein, Rich in healthy fats, Lactose free, Energetic, Gluten free
ingredients: 150gr of salmon, 1/2 cup of cooked brown rice, 1 cup of steamed broccoli, 1 tbsp of EVOO, Lemon, salt and pepper
instructions: Bake the salmon with salt, lemon and pepper (20' at 180ª), Cook the brown rice, Cook the steamed broccoli, Serve everything in a bowl and add EVOO

recipe_name: Lettuce tacos with grilled chicken
tag: High in protein, Gluten free, Lactose free, Low in carbohydrates
ingredients: 200gr of chicken breast, Romaine lettuce leaves, 1/4 avocado -1/2 tomato - 1/4 onion, Lemon and salt
instructions: Cook the chicken on the grill with lemon and salt, Cut into strips and serve on lettuce leaves, Add the avocado, tomato and onion, Serve with a few drops of lemon

recipe_name: Warm quinoa salad with chickpeas and spinach
ingredients: 1 cup of cooked quinoa, 1/2 cup of chickpeas, 2 cups of fresh spinach, 172 pepper - 1/4 of red onion, Juice of half a lemon, 1 tbsp of EVOO / Salt pepper to taste
instructions: Cook the quinoa and let it cool a bit, Sauté the chickpeas with a little oil, Add spinach until they soften, Mix everything in a bowl with the rest of the ingredients, Dress with lemon, salt and pepper

recipe_name: Green detox smoothie
tag: Vegan , Lactose free , Gluten free , Antioxidant , Low in carbohydrates
ingredients: 1 cup of spinach , 1/2 banana , 1/2 green apple , 1 cup of water or vegetable drink , Ice to taste
instructions: 1. Blend all the ingredients until you get a uniform shake   2. Serve cold

recipe_name: Mini Microwave Omelette
tag: Gluten free , Vegetarian , Low in carbohydrates , High in protein
ingredients: 2 eggs , 1 tbsp of chopped onion ,1 tbsp of chopped peppers , Salt and pepper
instructions: 1. Mix everything in a microwave-safe bowl , 2. Cook for 2-3min at maximum power

recipe_name: Apple with almond cream
ingredients: 1 sliced apple , 1 tbsp of almond cream
instructions: 1. Cut the apple , 2. Spread or dip in the almond cream

recipe_name: Cucumber Rolls with Cream Cheese and Turkey
ingredients: 1 cucumber , 3 slices of turkey , 2 tbsp of light cream cheese
instructions: 1. Cut thin strips of cucumber with a peeler ,    2. Spread cheese and add turkey   ,  3. Roll up and secure with a toothpick

recipe_name: Homemade Seed and Honey Bars
ingredients: 1/2 cup of mixed seeds ,  1/4 cup of honey  ,   1/2 cup of oats  ,  2 tbsp of almond cream

recipe_name: Rice cakes with avocado and lemon
ingredients: 2 Rice cakes,1/2 avocado,Juice of 1/4 lemon, Salt and pepper

recipe_name: Sopa Minestrone ligera

recipe_name: Chia pudding with coconut milk

ingredients: 2 tablespoons of chia seed,150ml of light coconut milk,1 teaspoon of agave syrup,Fruit to taste for decoration

recipe_name: Revuelto de huevo con champiñones y cebolla
ingredients: 2 huevos, 1/2 taza de champiñones, 1/4 de cebolla, 1 cda de AVOE, Sal y pimienta

recipe_name: Greek Yogurt with Red Fruits and Seeds
ingredients: 150gr of natural Greek yogurt, 1/2 cup of red fruits, 1 tsp of chia seeds, Sweetener (optional)

recipe_name: Crepes de avena con champiñones salteados
ingredients: 1/2 taza de avena molida, 1/2 taza de agua o bebida vegetal, 1/2 de champiñones, ajo, perejil y sal, Comino, pimentón y sal

recipe_name: Baked Kale Chips

recipe_name: Smoked salmon with avocado and arugula
ingredients: 60gr of smoked salmon, 1/4 avocado, 1 cup of arugula, Lemon, EVOO
